question_text: What was the average detection confidence across all events on 2025-12-08 (UTC)? Report to two decimal places.
answer_text: Average detection confidence on 2025-12-08 (UTC) was 0.91. This is based on 5,940 events with confidence reported (out of 437,940 total events).

citations.cypher:
MATCH (e:Event)
WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH avg(e.confidence) AS avg_conf, count(e) AS events_with_confidence
CALL {
  MATCH (e2:Event) WHERE e2.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e2.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN count(e2) AS n
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour) WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN sum(ch.event_count) AS n
}
RETURN CASE WHEN avg_conf IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE round(avg_conf * 100.0) / 100.0 END AS avg_confidence, events_with_confidence, sum(n) AS total_events
